concepts.quote: An empty array: it gives 0, but an empty array has no largest value.
concepts.why: The answer is right that an empty array leaves max at its start value 0. But it does not show the L4 trigger (all-negative data making max stay above every value), so it shows only the empty-array prediction.
It never mentions data.length or how the loop bound works. An empty array is only implied.
It says nothing about creating arrays.
It says nothing about separators or handling one item outside the loop.
